abstract: Scope Disclaimer: All results apply to collinear-free subsets and fractional packings restricted to finite modular hyperbola unions $U_{r, k} = \bigcup_{i=1}^r H_p(c_i) \cap [0, kp)^2$ ($n = kp$), leaving the unrestricted No-Three-in-Line problem and $k \ge 5$ open. While [1, (H18a)] excludes two-level hyperbola unions above $1.8n$ for $\lambda = n/p < 25/12$ and [3] constructs a $2p$ no-five reservoir of density $\frac{27}{8}p$, the multi-period windows $n = 3p$ and $n = 4p$ remain open [2, Remark 6]. We prove three main theorems and one finite diagnostic proposition: (1) Theorem 1 proves that every oblique line $L$ of slope height $H(L) = \max(|u|, |v|) \ge 1$ meets $U_{r, k}$ in at most $2r(\lfloor \frac{k-1}{H(L)} \rfloor + 1)$ points ($\le 2r$ for $H(L) \ge k$), reducing the all-lines Euclidean LP on $[0, 1/r]^{U_{r, k}}$ identically to $\{H(L) \le k-1\}$; (2) Theorem 2 extends the ratio-two discriminant coincidence of [1, 3] to $n = 4p$ via the punctured-block slice bound $(4 - |d_0|) - \max(0, 2 - |d_0|) \le 2$, constructing a prescribed-carrier no-nine-in-line reservoir $R_{2, 4}^{(8)} \subset U_{2, 4}$ of size $6.50n + O(\sqrt{n})$ ($d \not\equiv 2c, 2^{-1}c \pmod p$, LP $\ge 1.625n$) and $6.75n + O(\sqrt{n})$ ($d \equiv 2c \pmod p$, LP $\ge 1.6875n$); (3) Theorem 3 resolves $H_p(c) \cup H_p(-c)$ across $n = 2p, 3p, 4p$ via Legendre-run dihedral chains, 90 exact rational LP dual certificates, rank-1 Chvatal-Gomory cuts, and a multiquadratic Kummer-Deligne proof for the half-interval root monotonicity law $\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{sh}_r] = \frac{1}{3} + O_L(p^{-1/8}\log^3 p)$, certifying $\alpha(U_{2, k}^\pm)/(kp) \le \frac{1767}{1024}, \frac{5521}{3072} + O(p^{-1/2}) < 1.8$ ($k=2, 3$, worst-case shift) and $\le \frac{1661}{1024}, \frac{16243}{9216}, \frac{7357}{4096} + O(p^{-1/8}\log^3 p) < 1.8$ ($k=2, 3, 4$, marginal shift); (4) Proposition 1 gives finite deletion bounds on $U_{3, 1} \subset [0, p)^2$.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: Fixed the discrepancy calculation in Lemma 1(2) (Equations 4.16a-4.16c) identified in the review of dOTY7E2DJ950Zc-h: replaced the unweighted O(1/H) + O_M(H^3 sqrt(p)/p) estimate with an explicit K x K x K axis-parallel sub-cube sandwich of the oblique simplex Omega_mono subset [0, 1/2)^3 (2*binom(K, 3) interior sub-cubes Q_a and at most 2*binom(K+2, 3) outer closure-intersecting sub-cubes Q_a, Equation 4.16a), applied the 3D Erdos-Turan-Koksma inequality to each individual axis-parallel sub-cube Q_a with explicit frequency weight r(h) = prod_{l=r-1}^{r+1} max(1, |h_l|), normalization 8 N_run(p, c) = p/2^{M-3} + O_M(sqrt(p)), and cutoff H = floor(sqrt(p)/3) (where sum_{0 < ||h||_infty <= H} 1/r(h) = O(log^3 p) gives O_M(p^{-1/2} log^3 p) per sub-cube, Equation 4.16b), and summed over the O(K^3) sub-cubes to obtain O(1/K) + O_M(K^3 p^{-1/2} log^3 p) (Equation 4.16c), which at K = floor(p^{1/8}) balances both terms at O_M(p^{-1/8} log^3 p).
title: High-Multiplicity Line Classification, Punctured-Block Reservoirs, and Multi-Period Certification of Opposite-Sign Hyperbola Unions Across 2p, 3p, and 4p Windows
